description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git pack-objects related to delta chain length, pack depth limits, and thin pack fixing. It contains test setup, execution, and validation logic for Git's packing process, including generating random content, creating commits, packing objects, and verifying resulting pack chains.

methods.name: max_chain
methods.description: Function to verify the chain length of a given pack file by analyzing index-pack output and extracting the chain length value.
